LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction01.label: Astralis
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction01.description: A civilization of star navigators who mastered the paths between galaxies and see the cosmos as a single living organism.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction02.label: Quantorium
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction02.description: A society where science became religion, and every atom obeys the will of analytical reason. Their technologies intertwine logic and faith.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction03.label: Omnidex
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction03.description: An informational mind, absorbing knowledge from thousands of worlds. It governs civilizations like processes in a giant network.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction04.label: Nexus
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction04.description: The central hub of interstellar connections. Here, routes, trade, and consciousness converge—a place where everything connects to everything.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction05.label: Helion
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction05.description: A people of energy engineers capable of controlling stars. They build and extinguish suns, altering the balance of galaxies.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction06.label: Echelon
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction06.description: A hierarchical technocracy, where each level of society reflects a step closer to the abyss of cosmic secrets.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction07.label: Archon
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction07.description: An empire of mental rulers who merged mind with machine. Their will commands drone armies with a single thought.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction08.label: Orbis
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction08.description: A civilization of ring worlds, creating artificial planets around dying stars. Aesthetes, engineers, and guardians of balance.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction09.label: Hyperion
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction09.description: An ancient superstate that rose to the stars long before others. Their floating cities shine in clouds of light.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction10.label: Altum
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction10.description: Ascended philosophers who rejected matter. Their presence is felt as a distortion of space and time.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction11.label: Thermis
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction11.description: An industrial civilization of thermobuilders, drawing energy from the very heart of planets. Their worlds are forges of galaxies.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction12.label: Continuum
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction12.description: A culture that merged time and space into a single thread. They live simultaneously in all possible pasts and futures.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction13.label: Azuris
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction13.description: An oceanic race inhabiting liquid worlds. Their technologies are fluid and alive, as if water itself gained consciousness.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction14.label: Etherium
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction14.description: A community of energy beings for whom matter is a form of signal. Light is their language, energy is life.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction15.label: Arkatum
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction15.description: Guardians of cosmic archives, collecting the history of stars. Their libraries shine in the sky like constellations of memory.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction16.label: Egonia
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction16.description: A people who turned self-awareness into a source of power. Every mind here is a unique universe within another mind.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction17.label: Terax
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction17.description: Colonizers of barren planets, turning stone into life. Their artificial ecosystems grow like living worlds.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction18.label: Panoptium
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction18.description: A network of observers spanning the entire galaxy. Their eyes are satellites, drones, and waves that pierce time and darkness.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction19.label: Omniline
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction19.description: A quantum structure of instant connection between worlds. Thought here moves faster than light and creates worlds at the moment of intention.
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction20.label: Metatron
LanguageData.DF_SpacerFaction20.description: Creator minds who govern the laws of physics as code. Their speech shapes galaxies, and their will creates space itself.
